scope: Archived historical application summaries and secondary diagnostics only; no new device run, public-backend parity, or new bevel result.
reproduction_boundary: Public verification recalculates secondary Menu statistics from the exported boundary rows and checks archived Sheet summary consistency. Sheet full profiles and edge pixels are not remeasured or refitted by render_figures.py.

sheet_profiles.purpose: Archived eight-rest horizontal body-profile errors; export only the after/rim4 mean and profile statistics. Profiles are not recomputed from raw pixels by the public figure renderer.

sheet_rim3_edges.purpose: Archived neutral/fine-grid edge RGB profile summary, rim3 baseline; inward 0..6 logical units, 8-bit channel values.

sheet_rim4_edges.purpose: Archived neutral/fine-grid edge RGB profile summary, rim4; retain light top degradation and dark residuals.

menu_secondary_grid.purpose: Secondary fine-grid dark menu threshold diagnostics, not primary shape validation. Export fixed 2..24 depth rows with all threshold crossings present; retain grid/rim/shadow contamination.

sheet_profile_method.purpose: Archived methodology: matched body input policy and distinction between mean RGB, complete horizontal profiles, and mismatched edge inputs.

sheet_edge_method.purpose: Archived edge method: 16 logical units tangential average, interpolated original pixel centers, inward 0..6 RGB-profile RMSE; rim3 to rim4 failure retained.

menu_secondary_method.purpose: Archived primary/secondary distinction, frozen fine-grid dark color thresholds 110/130/150, and native grid/rim/shadow dip explaining the retained outlier.

sheet_profile_method.metric: RMSE across same-coordinate horizontal RGB profiles in the declared foreground-free body strips
sheet_profile_method.input_policy: Periodic phase matched; tonal body strip shifted by two whole 224-unit periods; synthetic landscape full-screen UV matched. These are body regions, not whole sheets.
sheet_profile_method.roi_reference: body_rect_px in sheet-body.csv; original method and source hash recorded above.

sheet_edge_method.metric: Complete inward 0..6 logical-unit RGB profile RMSE
sheet_edge_method.sampling: Interpolate original pixel-center samples along the inward normal; preserve each actual pane position and size.
sheet_edge_method.limitations: Includes rasterization/refraction, native dimmed scene and possible native backing controls; not physical alpha or automatic optical parity.

menu_secondary_method.qualification: All native and Window threshold crossings present; not the primary flat/matched-input selection.
menu_secondary_method.limitations: Color crossings are not alpha. Grid/rim/shadow dips contaminate this secondary scene; the outlier is retained and was not used to tune Menu32.
